name: What types of renovations are most suitable for increasing rental income?

mainEntity.name: What types of renovations are most suitable for increasing rental income?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renovations most suitable for increasing rental income generally focus on modernizing key areas and enhancing functionality. Kitchen and bathroom remodels often yield the highest returns, as these are critical spaces for tenants. Upgrading appliances to energy-efficient models, adding durable, attractive flooring, and improving curb appeal through landscaping or exterior paint can also justify higher rents. Focusing on these areas can help your property stand out in competitive markets like Eagle or Kuna. We recommend discussing your property's specific needs and local market trends with a contractor who understands the rental market.
acceptedAnswer.description: To increase rental income, prioritize kitchen and bathroom remodels, energy-efficient appliance upgrades, and durable flooring. Enhancing curb appeal also helps attract tenants and justify higher rents.
